Name: Rose's Sweet Gem Berry Expanded
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
This is simple mod, it changes the label of the Sweet berry Gem into a Fruit. Allowing them to be turned into Dried Fruit, jelly, and wine. I made this for myself but i decided to publish it. I also make it edible. 

Update (10/1/2025): I added config, you can change Sweet Gem Berry Prices, 1000g - 2650g

(This mod was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4679]Sweet Gem Fruit -- Rare Rebalance [/url])(I like this mod a lot and it inspired me to make a similar mod for 1.6.)
(For these wondering what texture i am using in the photos, i am using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18769]DSHi Shipping Items Retexture[/url] by birDfiSHi)

[b]Also, Please dont forget to endorse the my mod please, so that way more people can see it. It helps inspires me to make mods/unofficial updates. ;)[/b]
